techniques 5
technique "FogTech" mmdpass=object usetexture=any usespheremap=any usetoon=any subset=all hardware=1 shadercaps=1 shadermix=1 script=0 empty=0 passes=1
  pass 0 "DrawObject" script=0 custom=1 psize15=0 shadermix=1
technique "FogTecBS0" mmdpass=object_ss usetexture=any usespheremap=any usetoon=any subset=all hardware=1 shadercaps=1 shadermix=1 script=1 empty=0 passes=3
  script "ClearSetColor=BackColor;RenderColorTarget=FogMap;Clear=Color;Pass=DrawFog;RenderColorTarget=FogBlurMap;Clear=Color;Pass=DrawLightShaft;RenderColorTarget=;Pass=DrawGodRay;"
  cmd 0 ClearSetColor param="BackColor" value=0 text="BackColor"
  cmd 1 RenderColorTarget0 param="FogMap" value=-1 text="FogMap"
  cmd 2 Clear param="-" value=1 text="Color"
  cmd 3 Pass pass="DrawFog" index=0 text="DrawFog"
  cmd 4 RenderColorTarget0 param="FogBlurMap" value=-1 text="FogBlurMap"
  cmd 5 Clear param="-" value=1 text="Color"
  cmd 6 Pass pass="DrawLightShaft" index=1 text="DrawLightShaft"
  cmd 7 RenderColorTarget0 param="-" value=0 text=""
  cmd 8 Pass pass="DrawGodRay" index=2 text="DrawGodRay"
  pass 0 "DrawFog" script=0 custom=1 psize15=0 shadermix=1
  pass 1 "DrawLightShaft" script=0 custom=1 psize15=0 shadermix=1
  pass 2 "DrawGodRay" script=0 custom=1 psize15=0 shadermix=1
technique "EdgeTec" mmdpass=edge usetexture=any usespheremap=any usetoon=any subset=all hardware=1 shadercaps=1 shadermix=1 script=0 empty=1 passes=0
technique "ShadowTech" mmdpass=shadow usetexture=any usespheremap=any usetoon=any subset=all hardware=1 shadercaps=1 shadermix=1 script=0 empty=1 passes=0
technique "ZplotTec" mmdpass=zplot usetexture=any usespheremap=any usetoon=any subset=all hardware=1 shadercaps=1 shadermix=1 script=0 empty=1 passes=0
selection subsets=2 clamped=0
  # name! = the technique matched but is invalid (fallback); - = no technique
  # modes 0 and 1 list the eight Use* states: index = usetexture | usespheremap<<1 | usetoon<<2
  select object 0-1 "FogTech" "FogTech" "FogTech" "FogTech" "FogTech" "FogTech" "FogTech" "FogTech"
  select object_ss 0-1 "FogTecBS0" "FogTecBS0" "FogTecBS0" "FogTecBS0" "FogTecBS0" "FogTecBS0" "FogTecBS0" "FogTecBS0"
  select shadow 0-1 "ShadowTech"
  select edge 0-1 "EdgeTec"
  select zplot 0-1 "ZplotTec"
runs
  run "FogTech"
    start rt0=main rt1=none rt2=none rt3=none ds=main.depth viewport=1000x600+0+0
    draw geometry pass=0 "DrawObject" rt0=main rt1=none rt2=none rt3=none ds=main.depth viewport=1000x600+0+0
    end rt0=main rt1=none rt2=none rt3=none ds=main.depth viewport=1000x600+0+0
    result suspended=0 draws=1 hr=0x00000000 runfailed=0
  run "FogTecBS0"
    start rt0=main rt1=none rt2=none rt3=none ds=main.depth viewport=1000x600+0+0
    draw geometry pass=0 "DrawFog" rt0=FogMap rt1=none rt2=none rt3=none ds=main.depth viewport=500x300+0+0
    draw geometry pass=1 "DrawLightShaft" rt0=FogBlurMap rt1=none rt2=none rt3=none ds=main.depth viewport=500x300+0+0
    draw geometry pass=2 "DrawGodRay" rt0=main rt1=none rt2=none rt3=none ds=main.depth viewport=1000x600+0+0
    end rt0=main rt1=none rt2=none rt3=none ds=main.depth viewport=1000x600+0+0
    result suspended=0 draws=3 hr=0x00000000 runfailed=0
